title: ANNCSU comuni gazetteer
description:
The comuni that have at least one address in ANNCSU, in one Parquet file in the index format of the STAC [gazetteer](https://github.com/cholmes/stac-gazetteer/blob/main/gazetteer/v1.0.0/README.md) extension. Each comune has its name, its province, its Istat code as `feature_id` and the bounding box of its access points. Names in another language, and spellings with a space in place of the apostrophe, are extra rows. Rows are sorted by `name_norm`, so a client finds a comune by name with a few HTTP range requests and no server; [`@cngeo/geocoder-core`](https://github.com/cholmes/cng-map-widgets/tree/main/packages/geocoder-core) reads this collection as it is.

The `feature_id` is the key the `indirizzi-index` collection uses to look up the streets of a comune. The data comes from the ANNCSU release of 2 November 2026.

index.title: Index of comuni names
index.description: One row per comune and one per alternate name, sorted by `name_norm` compared byte by byte, with exact min/max statistics and the sort declared in the footer.

table:columns.name: name
table:columns.description: The name to display, from the Istat list of comuni. On an alternate row it is the name in another language, or the same name when the row only changes name_norm.

table:columns.name: name_norm
table:columns.description: The name normalized by nfd-strip-marks-lower/1: NFD decomposition, diacritics removed, lowercase, characters other than letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens removed, repeated spaces collapsed. It is the sort column, compared byte by byte.

table:columns.name: level
table:columns.description: Administrative level, always 3: the level of comuni in geoBoundaries (ADM3) and in Who's On First (localadmin).

table:columns.name: country
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, always ITA.

table:columns.name: feature_id
table:columns.description: Istat code of the comune, six digits as text. Alternate rows repeat the code of their comune. It is the value of the codice_istat column in the address index.

table:columns.name: parent_name
table:columns.description: Name of the province, the supra-municipal territorial unit of Istat. It tells apart comuni with the same name.

table:columns.name: parent_id
table:columns.description: Istat code of the supra-municipal territorial unit.

table:columns.name: name_lang
table:columns.description: ISO 639-3 language of the name, for example deu or slv, on rows in another language. Null on the other rows.

table:columns.name: alt_of
table:columns.description: Null on the main row. On an alternate row, the feature_id of the comune the row is another name of.

table:columns.name: source
table:columns.description: Source of the row, always anncsu.

table:columns.name: addresses
table:columns.description: Number of georeferenced access points of the comune in the release, including those ANNCSU places outside the comune boundary.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct(xmin double, ymin double, xmax double, ymax double)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the comune's access points in WGS84 degrees, leaving out those outside the comune boundary; if all of them are, it covers all of them. It is narrower than the comune's territory.
